verdict.rationale: Modal documents the core loop for agents in its SDKs. Sandboxes are created programmatically from an image (modal-docs-2, modal-docs-20). Commands run via sb.exec, and output is read through a subprocess-like Sandbox object and a logs fetch/tail API (modal-docs-21, modal-docs-25, modal-docs-23). A first-party example has an LLM agent generating and executing code in a Sandbox (modal-docs-22, modal-docs-30), and a community developer reports driving Sandboxes from an agent runtime (modal-comm-2). missing for 10: an explicit documented terminate/teardown call (only implied by 'ephemeral'), and independent hands-on corroboration of the full unattended provision-to-teardown loop.
